text:
[IDSP.2.2] Dispatcher entry: `ds_dispatcher_log(engine,
level, rule_name, message)` — arguments arrive as typed
values:

| Arg | DS type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| level    | `ds_log_level_t` | One of DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR / CRITICAL — bad value → `DS_ERR_INVAL` |
| category | String           | the rule / category name, verbatim |
| message  | String           | verbatim |
